transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Um… I’m here because I’m having trouble finishing things at work. Like I’ll start the sanitation steps or the batch logs, or the end-of-line paperwork, and then somehow I leave out the last parts. Even when I know it really matters and my job depends on it.
Before you leave those tasks unfinished, do you get stuck checking them over and over because something feels wrong or unsafe?
No… I don’t think so. It’s not like I’m checking it again and again because it feels unsafe. I just… move on or miss the last part somehow.
When you were a child in school, did you often have the same kind of trouble finishing things or paying attention?

Yeah… I think so. My mom still has some of my old report cards, like from fourth grade, that said I was bright but needed a lot of reminders to finish classwork and turn in homework. I remember getting the lesson, mostly, but if the teacher wasn’t kind of nearby, I’d miss parts of the instructions.
Do you have the same kind of trouble finishing things at home, too?
Yeah… somewhat. It’s kind of the same thing as at work, I guess. I’ll start what I’m supposed to do and then just not finish the last part, even when I know I need to.
Do you often feel restless, like it’s hard to sit still?
I’m not really sure. I don’t think of myself as restless like that… not usually, anyway.
Do you spend a lot of time worrying about different parts of your life?
I mean… I worry sometimes, like anyone, but I don’t think it’s a lot or about everything. Not really.
Did these concentration problems start only after a medical illness or head injury?
I don’t think so… I mean, I can’t really tie it to anything like that. I don’t remember it starting after being sick or hitting my head.
